title: Role of Neuroinflammation and Blood-Brain Barrier Breakdown in Intracerebral Hemorrhage.
official:
Role of Neuroinflammation and Blood-Brain Barrier Breakdown in Intracerebral Hemorrhage.
The INFINITE Study
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the effect of perihematomal neuroimmune response, assessed by a quantitative measure of 18F-DPA-714 PET radiotracer uptake (binding within PHE) at day 10 ±2 after spontaneous ICH, on the functional outcome (poor versus favorable) at 6 months
